description: Hand a feature to Claude and get back working code, proven against its spec by integration tests or UI automation.

title: Sheet Viewer
description: View and edit Excel (.xlsx, .xls, .ods) and CSV/TSV files as a spreadsheet grid inside VS Code.

title: Element to Claude
description: Click an element on your localhost page: Claude Code gets its exact source and CSS lines, no screenshot. Alt+click jumps to its text or a CSS value, selected, for quick edits without the chat. For React (Vite, Next.js).

title: KIDDO Language Support (.kid)
description: Official KIDDO (.kid) language extension: file icons, syntax highlighting, auto-indent, autocomplete, snippets, Run/VM/Debug toolbar, and .exe builder.

title: ERMaster for VS Code
description: A modern ER Diagram editor for VS Code compatible with Eclipse ERMaster (.erm)

title: PairBridge
description: Share reviewed code folders with a teammate, browse live files, and copy snippets in native read-only VS Code editors.

title: Docquill – Python Docstring Generator (Google, NumPy, Sphinx) + AI
description: Type """ under a def to get a Google, NumPy or Sphinx docstring with your arguments, types, defaults, returns and raises filled in. Optional AI fill with your own key or a local model.
